$comment: Line-coverage floors per source file, enforced by scripts/check_coverage_floor.mjs (gate g). Every file under src/ must have a row here; a file with no row is an ERROR, and an unregistered file has no floor below 90. Values recorded on 2026-11-09 by measuring the pre-existing suite (see checkpoints/P0-09.md): the legacy numbers are today's truth, not a target. Floors only ever move up — `node scripts/check_coverage_floor.mjs --raise` rewrites them from a measured run and refuses to lower any.
